fields.name: Individual Portrait Session
fields.description: A one-hour portrait session for one person, in the studio or nearby, with 15 edited photos.
fields.information: Includes: 1 hour of shooting, up to 2 outfit changes, 15 professionally edited photos in an online gallery within 7 days, and all the unedited photos on request. Good for personal branding, birthdays and dating profiles. Location: our studio, or anywhere in the city area at no extra cost. Hair and make-up are not included, but we can recommend an artist.

fields.name: Couple Photoshoot
fields.description: A relaxed 90-minute shoot for two: anniversaries, proposals, pre-wedding teasers.
fields.information: Includes: 1.5 hours of shooting, up to 3 outfit changes, 30 edited photos within 7 days. We guide you on poses, so no modelling experience is needed. Popular locations: the Botanic Gardens, Tiong Bahru and Marina Bay at sunset (ask us for sunset timings). Pets are welcome.

fields.name: Family Portrait Session
fields.description: A 90-minute family session for up to 6 people, with kids and pets welcome.
fields.information: Includes: 1.5 hours of shooting for up to 6 people, 40 edited photos within 7 days, and one 8x10 inch print. Pets are welcome. We keep toys and snacks for little ones, and take breaks whenever they need. In the studio we have a white backdrop and a warm-toned living-room set; outdoor sessions are best in the morning before 10am.

fields.name: Newborn Session
fields.description: A gentle 3-hour newborn session in our heated studio, best in the first 14 days.
fields.information: Includes: up to 3 hours (with feeding and settling breaks), wraps, props and outfits for baby, family and sibling shots, 25 edited photos within 10 days. Studio only. Best booked when baby is 5 to 14 days old: you can book before the birth and move the date for free. Mei Lin is trained in newborn safety and posing; we never use unsafe poses.

fields.name: Maternity Shoot
fields.description: A 90-minute maternity shoot, ideally between 28 and 36 weeks.
fields.information: Includes: 1.5 hours, access to our maternity gown wardrobe (6 gowns, sizes S to XL), partner and family shots, 30 edited photos within 7 days. Best between 28 and 36 weeks. Studio or outdoors.

fields.name: Graduation Portraits
fields.description: One hour of graduation portraits in your gown, on campus or in the studio.
fields.information: Includes: 1 hour, solo and family shots, 20 edited photos within 7 days. On campus at NUS, NTU, SMU or SUTD at no extra cost, or in the studio. Bring your gown, hood and mortarboard; we have a spare mortarboard if needed. Flowers and props are not included.

fields.name: Corporate Headshots
fields.description: A quick 30-minute professional headshot session, with 5 retouched photos.
fields.information: Includes: 30 minutes on a grey, white or office-style backdrop, 5 retouched headshots within 3 working days, sized for LinkedIn and company websites. For a team, book one session per person. Wear what you would wear to work.

fields.name: Pet Photoshoot
fields.description: A playful one-hour shoot for your dog, cat or other pet (and you, if you like).
fields.information: Includes: 1 hour, 20 edited photos within 7 days. Up to 2 pets of the same household. Bring their favourite treats and toys. Dogs must be leashed outdoors. The 30-minute buffer after each pet shoot is for cleaning the studio, for guests with allergies.

fields.name: Badminton Court (1 hour)
fields.description: One indoor, air-conditioned badminton court for one hour, for singles or doubles (up to 4 players).
fields.information: Our 2 badminton courts are indoors, air-conditioned, with a sprung wooden floor, BWF-standard lines and nets, and no-glare lighting. Up to 4 players per court. Bookings start on the hour, from 9am to 8pm (the last one ends at 9pm); book two back-to-back slots for 2 hours. Non-marking indoor shoes are required. Please bring your own rackets and shuttlecocks: we don't rent or sell equipment.

fields.name: Tennis Court (1 hour)
fields.description: One outdoor, floodlit hard tennis court for one hour, for singles or doubles.
fields.information: Our 2 tennis courts are outdoor acrylic hard courts (medium pace), floodlit from 7pm, with benches and shade at each court. Bookings start on the hour, from 9am to 8pm (the last one ends at 9pm); book two back-to-back slots for 2 hours. If it rains and the court is unplayable, we move or refund your booking. Please bring your own rackets and balls: we don't rent or sell equipment.
